description: Crawl https://books.toscrape.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider to analyze server response times (TTFB). After the crawl completes, export the 'Internal > HTML' data (including the 'Response Time' column) to a CSV file in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/. Then, write a text report to ~/Documents/SEO/reports/ttfb_analysis.txt that includes: 1) Total URLs crawled, 2) Average response time, 3) The 5 slowest URLs, 4) Identification of slow URL patterns, and 5) At least 3 optimization recommendations.
